batch_scope: documentation, command-reference, and project-direction BOUNDED commands affected by the B1/website closeout

commands.observed_behavior: Dry-run by default. Computes the current command reference and synchronized entrypoint edits, then writes docs/reference, package manifest resource, and agent-facing entrypoint text only with --execute.
side_effects: local_bounded_write: sync_entrypoint_files may update reviewed command reference and entrypoint files only with --execute
local_bounded_write: package manifest resource is created or updated only with --execute
commands.dry_run_behavior: Default invocation reports changed paths and generated manifest metadata without writing.

commands.observed_behavior: Renders PROJECT_DIRECTION.yaml to stdout by default. With --output it writes only inside repository tmp/ after rejecting paths outside the repo or outside tmp/.
side_effects: local_bounded_write: tmp/*.md, tmp/*.txt, or tmp/*.json output only when --output is supplied
blocked_write: committed output paths and paths outside the repository are rejected
commands.dry_run_behavior: No explicit dry-run flag, but default invocation writes nothing and prints the rendering.

commands.observed_behavior: Builds an unregistered-document candidate report and optional strict-scope failure. It does not write files or mutate the registry.
side_effects: process-independent: no git, subprocess, file write, delete, or remote mutation observed in the CLI path

commands.observed_behavior: Dry-run only in the current implementation. Passing --execute returns a BLOCK payload because mutation is reserved for a later slice.
side_effects: none: current implementation renders reconcile state only
blocked_write: --execute exits BLOCK and does not write
commands.dry_run_behavior: Default invocation builds and renders a reconcile report without mutation.

commands.observed_behavior: Adds exactly one reviewed registry entry after validating class, path existence, duplicate state, and full candidate registry validity.
side_effects: local_bounded_write: docs documentation registry YAML is rewritten only after validation passes
blocked_write: invalid class, missing path, duplicate path, invalid registry, or invalid candidate registry all fail before write
commands.dry_run_behavior: No dry-run flag; the command is intentionally a single-entry bounded writer.

commands.observed_behavior: Requires --execute and a known plan step, but the current apply core intentionally supports only no-op confirm-current and defer operations and reports mutation=none.
side_effects: none: current apply implementation never edits, moves, archives, or deletes files
blocked_write: missing --execute, unknown step ids, and unsafe operations return BLOCK
commands.dry_run_behavior: Without --execute the command blocks rather than pretending to apply a plan.

commands.observed_behavior: Dry-run by default. With --execute, stamps missing lifecycle headers through a workspace mutation lock and only for computed bootstrap candidates.
side_effects: local_bounded_write: lifecycle headers are inserted or updated only with --execute
local_temp_or_lock_write: workspace mutation lock state may be used during execution
commands.dry_run_behavior: Default invocation reports candidate headers without writing.

commands.observed_behavior: Dry-run by default. Execution requires explicit selected ids and applies only computed lifecycle candidates, with additional guards for unknown ids and defer dates.
side_effects: local_bounded_write: selected archive, confirm-current, or defer actions only with --execute and explicit --only
local_temp_or_lock_write: workspace mutation lock state may be used during execution
blocked_write: missing --only, unknown ids, and invalid defer dates block before applying
commands.dry_run_behavior: Default invocation emits an action plan and mutation=none.

commands.observed_behavior: Renders a documentation registry summary by default. It writes a JSON report only when --report is provided.
side_effects: evidence_write: optional --report path writes documentation registry summary JSON
